title: megatron: torch-load-any @ checkpointing.py:2796 (sink unreachable)
install: git checkout <pinned tag> (source is vendored under lab/upstream_verify/upstream/)

root_cause.note: torch.load at checkpointing.py:2796 is a real unpinned sink, but its only caller load_biencoder_checkpoint passes args.use_distributed_optimizer positionally into get_checkpoint_name(release=...) and also passes release=False, so the call raises TypeError on every invocation. The sink is dead code in core_v0.19.2; not exploitable through any upstream entry point.

preconditions: attacker can write the Megatron biencoder checkpoint directory
steps: load the verbatim pinned checkpointing.py with megatron siblings stubbed
call the real load_biencoder_checkpoint against a poisoned checkpoint directory
record that the caller fails before torch.load
expected_evidence: unsupported.json with the observed TypeError and the callee signature
cleanup: temporary checkpoint directory under evidence/ is rewritten on every run

static_analysis: Unsafe torch.load without weights_only; duplicate of CVE-2026-65110 at a newer tag. 0.19.2 import needs triton/GPU on this host, so the candidate itself is not dynamically reproduced.
